facts: Wind World (India) Limited operation and maintenance business undertaking
Vibhav Energy Private Limited, wholly owned subsidiary of Inox Green Energy Services Limited
The O&M business transfer remains conditional on satisfaction of conditions precedent under the executed business transfer agreement
Acquisition as a going concern of Wind World (India) Limited's wind operation-and-maintenance business under NCLT-approved insolvency resolution plan

₹550 crore consideration funded by ₹250 crore equity subscription and ₹200 crore inter-corporate deposit from Inox Green, plus ₹100 crore inter-corporate deposit from Authum; portions may convert later into Vibhav securities
unresolved_questions: Conditions-precedent satisfaction and legal transfer completion remain unproven in this filing.
Commercial quality, revenue/profitability and acquired contract liabilities of the WWIL O&M undertaking are not quantified here.
Future conversion of inter-corporate deposits may change Vibhav economics or ownership; evaluate entire financing agreement.
extraction_caveats: Payment and execution of BTA do not mean closing; do not label the acquisition completed.
The borrower/subsidiary funding mix is not equivalent to an immediate consolidated ₹550 crore operating profit gain.
document_rows.case_assessment: Substantive acquisition opportunity: Inox Green-backed subsidiary has paid ₹550 crore for WWIL O&M undertaking, but BTA conditions, business cash flows and eventual financing dilution are unresolved.

facts: TASL Automobile Solutions Private Limited, promoter-group company and investee

TVS Srichakra's 911,741 shares (7.58%) in private investee TASL Automobile were cancelled/extinguished through selective capital reduction; issuer received ₹34.44 crore at an investee exit price of ₹377.70 per TASL share
unresolved_questions: Impact on consolidated financial statements, taxes and net distributable proceeds is not established in this filing.
